title: PipeSync plan upload from explorer
description:
On the Plans page, + PDF / + Raster (and folder Add PDF) opened a file dialog but never imported the files. Explorer-only mode does not mount the plan board, so the change handler for the hidden file input never ran — uploads looked broken and the progress bar never appeared.

This release wires a programmatic file picker for explorer uploads, keeps explorer DnD/file inputs active without a board host, shows a clearer upload progress bar, and coerces empty PDF/image MIME types from the filename so Wasabi presign does not reject them.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plans on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until you apply the next platform release from cPanel.
changeLog: Fix Plans explorer + PDF / + Raster upload (files now import and show progress).
Keep explorer upload wiring active in explorer-only mode (no open board required).
Add/visible plan upload progress bar styling on desktop and mobile.
Coerce empty plan file MIME types from filename before Wasabi presign.
